answer: A hard Sybil check is the non-transferable deposit every candidate agent must post before payout, fully slashed when cluster analysis links two handles to one funding source. Attackers need a fresh attested funding path per handle: no shared harbor, no quiet haven, no common jetty to park clones. Each fake identity costs roughly one honest entry stake plus expected penalty, so N clones cost N times that, while one flagged cluster burns the whole stake rather than a slice.
